member.name: T:AntGarden.Core.MiniJson
member.summary: Minimal JSON parser. Objects become Dictionary<string, object> (a repeated key keeps the last value, as in JSON.parse), arrays List<object>, numbers double, plus string, bool and null.
member.remarks: Numbers with at most ~15 significant digits and a decimal exponent within ±22 (every number in the Path Recognize networks) are converted exactly with one correctly rounded operation, so the result never depends on the runtime's double.Parse. Longer numbers fall back to double.Parse (correctly rounded on .NET Core 3+, Mono may differ in the last bit). Stateless and thread-safe.
